content:
**Route 95A** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

The roadway runs south to north, on the western outskirts of Morgantown. Its southern end starts at an intersection with Highway 64, then crosses Route 95, takes a right turn, passes Mama Dolce's Food Processing and the Portside Pub.

It then crosses the road leading to the Morgantown Trainyard, passes through Morgantown Airport and Morgantown Station, before turning west-northwest. It then passes some railroad tracks, before approaching Wilson Brother's Auto Repair and terminating at an intersection with I-59.
